prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead summary` shows `time 0h 44m` for a flat 3.74 km walk. By Naismith's rule that is 44.9 minutes, and the README says times are rounded to the nearest minute." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files; grep -rn "time\|naismith\|round\|int(" --include=*.py . | grep -v test | head -50; grep -n -i "round\|minute" README*
sed -n 50,70p src/trailhead/report.py; sed -n 28,45p src/trailhead/plan.py; grep -rn "h [0-9][0-9]m" tests | head -20
cat src/trailhead/pace.py; sed -n 1,15p src/trailhead/report.py; sed -n 1,10p src/trailhead/plan.py; cat tests/test_pace.py | head -20

python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/trailhead/pace.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from math import exp\n","from math import exp, floor\n")
s=s.replace('''def tobler_kmh''','''def format_duration(hours: float) -> str:
    """Display a duration as ``<hours>h <minutes>m``, rounded to the nearest minute.

    Halves round up: 44.5 minutes is ``0h 45m``.
    """
    whole, minutes = divmod(floor(hours * 60 + 0.5), 60)
    return f"{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"


def tobler_kmh''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/trailhead/report.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from trailhead.pace import naismith_hours","from trailhead.pace import format_duration, naismith_hours")
s=s.replace("    whole, minutes = divmod(int(summary.hours * 60), 60)\n","")
s=s.replace('{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"','{format_duration(summary.hours)}"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/trailhead/plan.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from trailhead.pace import leg_hours","from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours")
s=s.replace("        whole, minutes = divmod(int(hours * 60), 60)\n","")
s=s.replace('{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"','{format_duration(hours)}"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_pace.py <<'EOF'


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("hours", "expected"),
    [
        (3.74 / 5, "0h 45m"),  # 44.88 min: the reported bug, used to truncate to 44m
        (0.35, "0h 21m"),  # 0.35 * 60 is 20.999... in floating point
        (44.4 / 60, "0h 44m"),
        (44.5 / 60, "0h 45m"),
        (59.6 / 60, "1h 00m"),
        (5 + 7 / 60, "5h 07m"),
        (12.0, "12h 00m"),
    ],
)
def test_format_duration_rounds_to_nearest_minute(hours, expected):
    assert format_duration(hours) == expected
EOF
sed -i 's/^from trailhead.pace import leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh/from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh/' tests/test_pace.py
git diff src; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15
